platform: GitHub Pages PWA + Google Play TWA; Chrome MV3 source retained
product_thesis: الدين ثابت والمشكلة تختلف؛ تدارُك بوابة يومية تربط المستخدم بالقرآن والذكر والعلم وتساعده في مشكلاته الواقعية بمصدر ظاهر وخطوة عملية.
non_negotiables: Every religious claim displayed in the app must have a visible source; unsourced religious claims are removed or rewritten.
Fiqh al-Nafs content is educational synthesis inspired by Makany methodology unless a specific quote is verified.
Mental-health content never replaces qualified medical/psychological care.
Nightly review stays lightweight: 5 essentials, quick choices, optional mood, one optional tomorrow note.
Age and male/female personalization is local-only and used only where meaningful.
Do not invent sacred counts, durations, promises, or spiritual ranks.
Keep + / Saved for later across content.
Do not restore the previously rejected home-page tagline; preserve the current calmer copy.

The Ishkaliat track is opt-in, does not classify religiosity, and every displayed idea links to the original Dr. Ahmed Abdelmonem video + timestamp; supplied summaries are not treated as verbatim transcripts.
Existing user data is production legacy data: no persistent key/shape/content-ID change without a backward-compatible migration and rollback path.
AI_HANDOFF.md is immutable project continuity: never delete/rename/truncate/exclude it; append every session chat/change ledger.
Google Play package identity for current listing is com.tadaruqnoor.rafiq; do not generate future Play bundles under a different package ID.
Never commit Android signing keystore/passwords or API/Play credentials.
Tazkiyah retention must come from useful study depth, resume/review and practical application; never label the user with spiritual ranks or use manipulative dark-pattern engagement.

current_release_changes: R24 expands source-backed study depth across 69 Tazkiyah reading topics/scenarios: 9 أعمال القلوب, 10 أمراض القلوب, 22 العقبة scenarios, 15 فقه النفس topics, and 13 إشكاليات lectures.

The 9 أعمال القلوب receive the strongest authored four-stage curriculum: التعريف والفهم → في القرآن والسنة → في هدي أهل العلم والصالحين → تطبيق عملي; new level-3 material was individually source-verified.

Other Tazkiyah sections use section-appropriate four-stage progression built from their already-source-backed fields rather than inventing filler claims: heart diseases = definition/causes/revelation/treatment; obstacles = situation/why/answer/steps; Fiqh al-Nafs = idea/psychological understanding/faith compass/questions+application; Ishkaliat = intro/early points/deeper points/full original lecture context.

Masari and Bank of Deeds intentionally keep action/progress semantics instead of receiving fake religious ranks. The whole Tazkiyah return loop is useful depth, resume/review and application—not points or piety scores.
Progress is explicitly framed as depth of study, never a spiritual rank. No sacred counts, artificial time locks, guilt prompts, or ad/revenue hooks were added.

qalb-levels-v1 remains the persistent local progress key. Works keep their original R23 plain IDs for backward compatibility; new section topics use composite depth IDs such as problem:..., obstacle:..., nafs:..., ish:....

R24 adds optional completedAt/lastAt/reviews fields backward-compatibly and fixes R23 Data Safety omission by registering qalb-levels-v1 as protected object data in backups/snapshots/restores. Local schema remains 2.
All published stage items are validated to have visible source data. CONTENT_PROVENANCE-TAZKIYAH.md documents the authored works sources and the source-field mapping used by the other sections.
Chrome MV3 manifest version is 24.4.0; service-worker cache/runtime names are R24 because both qalb.json and ishkaliat.json changed.
Deterministic QA covers 69 topics and 374 staged sourced items plus Data Safety. Real visual/mobile browser testing remains pending because the build sandbox blocks local Chromium navigation.
